about: Every natively typed member of Emerald, for editors and tools. Completion, hover, and signature help read it, and a test in the checker proves it names exactly the members the checker accepts. Each summary is one plain sentence for learners, in the website reference's voice; page is the member's anchor under https://emerald-lang.web.app/docs/.
